news.title: Michael Saylor’s Strategy buys 3,273 bitcoin as it inches closer to its 1 million target
news.summary: Strategy, the largest corporate holder of bitcoin in the world, now holds 818,334 BTC, which it said it purchased for nearly $62 billion at an average price of roughly $75,537 per token.

news.title: As the bitcoin price rises, futures may look bearish, but they're not, analyst says
news.summary: Research firm 10x says the negative funding rates reflect structural hedging by institutions, not a broad bearish play.

news.title: Canada’s crypto donation ban clears key vote with support from Conservatives
news.summary: Bill C-25, the Strong and Free Elections Act, cleared second reading Friday and heads to committee as Conservative lawmakers raise but don’t challenge the proposed ban on bitcoin contributions

news.title: Fidelity Digital Assets says bitcoin is leading crypto market stabilization
news.summary: Despite muted prices to start the second quarter, the report said improving onchain metrics and network activity point to a market finding its footing.

news.title: Bitcoin is climbing on thin volume, leaving rally vulnerable to macro shock
news.summary: Low trading volume and a lack of conviction from big-money bettors could leave the bitcoin rally on shaky ground, said 10x Research head Markus Thielen.

news.title: Financial Services Roundup: Market Talk
news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
